evidence.quote: d Serum samples for albumin and calcium for screening and routine monitoring of predialysis cCa.

When albumin is less than 4.0 g/dL, the calcium level will be corrected according to the formula: cCa (mg/dL) = total Ca (mg/dL) + (4 – albumin (g/dL))*0.8. Corrected calcium results will inform dosing/dose withholding at the next hemodialysis treatment.

measurements.name: Vital Signs
measurements.position_or_condition: Subjects will remain seated for at least 10 minutes prior to measurement of predialysis heart rate and blood pressure

evidence.quote: e Subjects will remain seated for at least 10 minutes prior to measurement of predialysis heart rate and blood pressure. Vital signs will include blood pressure, heart rate, respiratory rate, and oral or ear temperature. Vital signs will be obtained pre-dialysis treatments on scheduled dialysis days, and at ET and on Day 55 (EOS).
Vital signs, including heart rate, blood pressure, respiration rate and oral or ear temperature will be recorded by the investigator or qualified designee at screening,
Subjects must be seated position for at least 10 minutes prior to vital signs measurements.

measurements.name: 12-Lead Electrocardiograms
measurements.position_or_condition: supine position in a rested and calm state for at least 5 minutes

evidence.quote: f Subjects will remain supine for at least 5 minutes prior to recording 12-lead electrocardiogram (ECG). Screening 12-lead ECG will be recorded prior to hemodialysis. The Day -2 12-lead ECG will be recorded within 4 hours after hemodialysis rinse back.

The subject must be in supine position in a rested and calm state for at least 5 minutes before ECG assessment is conducted. If the subject is unable to be in the supine position, the subject should be in most recumbent position as possible.
The ECG must include the following measurements: heart rate, QRS, QT, QTc, and PR intervals.

evidence.quote: Weight (in kg and without shoes) will be obtained at screening, 2 days prior to dosing (Day -2), Day 1, Day 29 and Day 55 (EOS). On a hemodialysis day, weight will be recorded before dialysis.

notes: Protocol version: the PDF holds the protocol Amgen 20140197 as amended by Amendment 3 (25 May 2018) on PDF pages 1-73, followed by the Amendment 3 summary of changes (pages 74-87) and only the first page each of the Amendment 2 (20 Sep 2017, page 88) and Amendment 1 (08 March 2017, page 89) summaries. The SoA (Table 1a/1b/1c, pages 32-36, footnotes pages 33 and 35) comes from the Amendment 3 protocol body; extraction is from that version. No amendment later than Amendment 3 is in the PDF. Conflict recorded (rule 5/11): the Amendment 3 summary of changes reprints Table 1b footnotes (page 83) with two sentences that the protocol body (page 35) does not carry - footnote b adds 'Pregnancy tests will be performed in women of child bearing potential within 7 days prior to start of investigational product.' and footnote e adds 'Baseline iPTH is the average of predialysis iPTH levels on day -2 (may be collected up to -4 if needed) and day 1.' Both are recorded as additional lab_and_purpose entries (Serum or Urine Pregnancy (females only); iPTH) with page 83 evidence. Otherwise the summary-of-changes text (Table 1a footnotes e/f/g, Table 1b, Table 2, 7.2.x lists) matches the body; it also shows the superseded wording (pre-Amendment 3 Day -2 ECG '15 minutes after hemodialysis rinse back', 'pulse rate'), not recorded as entries. Amendment 2 rationale (page 88) states oral temperature, urine pregnancy, syphilis and optional B ultrasound were added and Bicarbonate removed from Chemistry - consistent with the body. Rule 10: Table 2 (page 44, three columns Chemistry / Hematology / Other Labs) runs its columns together in the text layer; checked against the page image (page 44) - the text-layer order matches the column assignment, no change. Page 36 (Table 1c) was also checked from the image to confirm the 'Central Laboratory' band covers all PK rows. No page lacks a text layer, so no entry is marked read_from page image. Panels: Table 2 gives no specimen and no lab for its panels (only 'analyzed by standard laboratory procedures'); 7.2.1 says 'All inclusion and exclusion central laboratory requirements must be met' (page 37) without naming which tests; Urea/BUN for Kt/V or URR is performed locally (Table 2 footnote d). Table 3 (page 46) gives blood volumes by test. Instruments: no questionnaire, rating scale or diary is named for an SoA activity; the only instrument recorded is the CTCAE version 4 adverse event grading scale (Adverse Event Monitoring). Measurements: physical examination components are not listed (only complete at screening, excluding genital and rectal examination, and abbreviated later). Demographics (sex, age, race, ethnicity) not recorded as a measurement. Abbreviations: glossary pages 7-9 transcribed line by line; on page 8 the text layer interleaves IVR/IWR and KDIGO and on page 9 SHPT and Study Day 1 - pairs assigned by the order of the definitions. The glossary prints SAE as 'severe adverse event' and P as 'Phosphorous' (as printed). cCa is defined twice: 'Total serum albumin corrected calcium concentration' (glossary, page 7) and 'albumin-corrected calcium' (under Table 1b, page 35). Added from under the SoA tables: ET, HD (page 33), cCa, SDA, Kt/V (page 35); from Table 2: TSH (page 44). Tokens in SoA activity names that no abbreviation list defines: BP, PT, aPTT, 'Hep C Ab' (glossary has HepCAb), PK (defined only in body text, page 16: 'pharmacokinetics (PK)'), 25(OH) (Table 2 / 7.3.13 spell 25-hydroxyvitamin D). SoA rows with little or no description in the text: Hemodialysis symptoms (only Table 1a footnote c); Phosphorus (no specimen/lab/purpose stated beyond Table 2 and the Day -2 waiver); Eligibility, Prior medications, Medical and surgical history, Informed consent (procedural). Cross-references: the second soa_cross_references input is an extraction note about the missing Table 1c footnote 'a' definition, not protocol text; its target 'Table 1' was resolved to Table 1 (page 32) and the Table 1b footnote a text (page 35).
